title: Zoto Spec System Execution Strategy
description: The optional `## Execution Strategy` YAML block of a spec index. A spec without the block, or with `execution_strategy: phased`, runs as a dependency graph in phases. `loop` runs an event-driven iterate-until-intent-met loop bounded by loop, time and cost or token limits. See `docs/execution-strategies.md`.

execution_strategy.description: `phased` runs subtasks by dependency phase (the default). `loop` iterates small change sets until every check passes or a limit is reached.

evals.description: Optional evaluation provider. `jev` scores loop checks and guards inputs with Jev (TypeSafe); `local` uses deterministic checks only. The string shorthand `evals: jev` equals `{ provider: jev }`.

max_loops.description: Maximum iterations. The loop stops with `stop_reason: max_loops` after this many check runs.

max_duration_minutes.description: Wall-clock limit from the first iteration's start.

max_cost_usd.description: Spend limit in US dollars for agent and eval turns. At least one of `max_cost_usd` and `max_tokens` is required.

max_tokens.description: Token limit (input + output + cache) across every agent and eval turn.

swarm_size.description: Agents working an iteration at once. Capped by `spec.parallelLimit`.

batch_size.description: Most outstanding items (failing checks) one iteration takes on. Keeps each change set small.

max_stalled_loops.description: Stop early when this many consecutive iterations leave the same checks failing.

checks.description: What the ready event runs against the build. The loop is done when every check passes.

covers.description: Criteria this check proves: `R01` (requirement 1), `DoD01` (spec Definition of Done item 1), `02` (all of subtask 02), `02.D01` (deliverable 1 of subtask 02), `02.DoD01` (Definition of Done item 1 of subtask 02).

kind.description: `review`: the adversarial spec judge verifies the covered items. `static`: non-executing inspection (syntax, package contract). `test`: run a command; exit 0 passes. `jev`: one Jev yes/no question per check. `agent_eval`: an Agent SDK eval case.

description.description: What the check proves. Required for `static` checks, where it names the inspection.

run.description: Command for `test` checks, run from the repo root.

question.description: Yes/no question for `jev` checks. Yes means the covered criteria are met.

threshold.description: Probability a `jev` check needs to pass. Defaults to `evals.threshold` (0.85).

eval.description: Eval case id (or file prefix) for `agent_eval` checks, run in `agent_sdk.project`.

guard_inputs.description: Score user-typed input (criteria, follow-up cards, fix text) for prompt injection before agents see it.

score_checks.description: Whether Jev may score checks. A spec with Jev checks must set this true.

model.description: Jev model id. Defaults to the provider default (`jev-latest`).

version.description: Pinned SDK version the project is validated against.

project.description: Repo-relative Agent SDK project directory with `bot/agent.ts`, `bot/instructions.md` and `evals/`.

eval_tag.description: Optional tag that selects the cases `agent_eval` checks may run.
